description.value:
You open a conduit to the space between planes, firing a beam of pulsing violet-white light harvested from the interplanar void. This beam is part of the Extraplanar series — a set of spells that channel the same interplanar radiance at different scales: Extraplanar Pulse (rank 2) sends a burst of this energy from a central point, and Extraplanar Beam projects it as a focused line.

Each creature in the line takes 8d12 vitality damage. A creature that critically fails its save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Blinded]{Blinded} until the start of your next turn; this blindness is caused by the overwhelming interplanar light.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Blinded]{Blinded} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.
